reason: An interactive in-memory Snake game plugin for DeepSeek Harness that lets an agent play deterministic turns while users view ASCII board state, scores, reasoning, and replay history.

summaries.zh: 一个供智能体在 DeepSeek Harness 中运行确定性贪吃蛇游戏的插件，支持查看 ASCII 棋盘、分数、决策理由和完整回合历史。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for deterministic agent-played Snake games with ASCII board rendering, scores, decision reasons, and complete turn history.

capabilities: Runs a deterministic Snake game in memory
Renders an ASCII board with score and status
Records and returns game history and decision reasons
